::: {.content-visible when-format="docx"}
# Book_14 — OrgPath with Third-Party DDI Platforms
:::


::: {.callout-note}
The DDI control plane — DNS, DHCP, and IP address management — governed by OrgPath through Infoblox Extensible Attributes, BloxOne tags, and BlueCat User-Defined Fields. Infoblox is the **permanent** authority for DHCP and IPAM (Azure has no scope-based DHCP service and no authoritative hybrid IPAM); DNS authority is the one surface that can migrate to Azure native. Covers the OrgPath bridge, the permanent DHCP and IPAM authority, the MigrationPhase state machine for the DNS surface, parallel-phase reconciliation, and the boundary where DNS exits to Azure while DHCP and IPAM remain. Companion to the [Old AD vs New EntraID foundational reference](../learning/old-ad-vs-new-entra-reference.qmd).
:::
